title: 自動化證書架構基礎 — Prisma 模型 + S3 儲存設定
content:
建立自動化證書系統的資料庫模型與儲存基礎設施。

Prisma 模型 - Certificate:
- id: Int (PK, autoincrement)
- registrantId: Int (FK → Registrant)
- courseId: Int (FK → Course)
- certificateNumber: String (unique, format: CERT-YYYY-NNNNN)
- antiForgeryId: String (unique, UUID — for verification URL)
- verificationUrl: String (URL to verify certificate authenticity)
- issuedAt: DateTime
- issuedById: Int (FK → User, admin who issued)
- pdfUrl: String? (S3 URL for stored PDF)
- status: CertificateStatus (ISSUED, REVOKED)

S3 設定：
- 新增 S3 Bucket 或使用現有 bucket 的 certificates/ prefix
- 上傳方式：直接上傳（非 presigned URL，因為是 server-side）
- PDF 命名：certificates/{certificateNumber}.pdf

⚠️ Anti-forgery 機制 TBC（等待決策：QR code + verification URL vs 純 sequential ID）。此卡先支援 UUID + verification URL，若後續決策變更再調整。

⚠️ 依賴課程資料的 certificateIssuer / certificateTitle 欄位（CD-011 已處理）。
acceptance: Prisma migration creates Certificate table with all specified fields
Certificate model has unique certificateNumber and antiForgeryId
S3 client configured to upload to certificates/ prefix
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: prisma/schema.prisma (update — add Certificate model + CertificateStatus enum)
src/lib/aws.ts (update — ensure S3 has certificates/ prefix access)
verification: npx prisma migrate dev --name add_certificate_model && npm run typecheck && Certificate table exists with all fields in DB.
